title: How Far May You Drop for Embedded Ball Relief?
question: Your ball is embedded in the fairway and you take free relief. How far from the reference point may you drop?
explanation: When taking free relief for a ball embedded in the general area, including the fairway, the player must drop a ball within one club-length of the reference point (the spot right behind where the ball was embedded), not nearer the hole.

There is a visible reference point next to the embedded ball, such as a tee or small marker. The fairway grass looks neatly mown under sunny daylight.
